name: GHL Review Requests and Recovery (Claude + n8n)

parameters.content:
## 1. Receive events from GoHighLevel
The GoHighLevel workflows (see ghl/native-workflows.md) call this webhook with the shared secret in the X-Review-Secret header: when a review request or reminder goes out, and when a customer replies. The webhook answers 200 at once and works afterwards. A wrong secret gets a 401 and an alert.

parameters.errorMessage: A call to the review events webhook arrived without the right shared secret and was ignored. If real events land here, check REVIEW_WEBHOOK_SECRET and the X-Review-Secret header in the GoHighLevel workflows.

={{ 'The review ' + $('Read Event').first().json.stampLabel + ' to contact ' + $('Read Event').first().json.contactId + ' went out, but its time was not saved on the contact, so the weekly digest will not count it: ' + String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || JSON.stringify($json.error))) || 'unknown error').slice(0, 300) + '. Check GHL_FIELD_REQUEST_SENT_ID, GHL_FIELD_REMINDER_SENT_ID and the contacts.write scope.' }}

parameters.content:
## 2. Read the reply
Loads the contact and the last messages. Repeat deliveries, contacts outside the review flow and replies after REPLY_WINDOW_DAYS are ignored. STOP and the other opt out words are handled in code before any AI. People already with a person only raise a Slack note. After MAX_AI_REPLIES assistant messages, a person takes over.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Could not load GoHighLevel contact ' + $('Read Event').first().json.contactId + ' after they replied "' + $('Read Event').first().json.text.slice(0, 200).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') + '", so the reply was not handled. Answer them by hand. ' + String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || JSON.stringify($json.error))) || 'unknown error').slice(0, 300) }}

parameters.content:
## 3. Classify with Claude
One Claude call with a forced tool call: praise, complaint, question, opt out or other. The reply text is checked in code: no links, no mention of reviews or ratings, no offers. If it fails the check, a fixed text is used.

## 4. Act
Complaint: a GoHighLevel task for the owner with a due date, and a note on the contact. Opt out: DND for the channel they used (other channels kept). If GoHighLevel refuses the DND update, an URGENT alert says to set it by hand.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'URGENT: ' + $('Build Reply Context').first().json.name.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') + ' (' + ($('Build Reply Context').first().json.phone || $('Build Reply Context').first().json.email) + ') asked to stop messages, but GoHighLevel did not accept the DND update. Set DND for ' + $('Build Reply Context').first().json.dndLabel + ' by hand now' + ($('Build Reply Context').first().json.cancelId ? ', and check that the reply scheduled for ' + $('Build Reply Context').first().json.pendingLabel + ' is cancelled' : '') + '. ' + String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || JSON.stringify($json.error))) || 'unknown error').slice(0, 300) }}

parameters.content:
## 5. Reply, tag and alert
One place decides the message back, the tags, the Slack alert and whether the run fails (also when Slack refuses the alert). An SMS outside SEND_HOUR_START to SEND_HOUR_END in the customer's time zone is scheduled in GoHighLevel for the morning. Nothing here touches the review request: no tag the GoHighLevel workflows read is added or removed.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ [$('Finish Reply').first().json.fail, ($('Slack: Alert').isExecuted && $('Slack: Alert').first().json.error ? 'The Slack alert could not be posted (' + String($('Slack: Alert').first().json.error.message || $('Slack: Alert').first().json.error.description || JSON.stringify($('Slack: Alert').first().json.error)).slice(0, 200) + '), so here it is: ' + $('Finish Reply').first().json.alert : '')].filter(Boolean).join(' ') }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ [$('Finish Reply').first().json.fail, ($('Slack: Alert').isExecuted && $('Slack: Alert').first().json.error ? 'The Slack alert could not be posted (' + String($('Slack: Alert').first().json.error.message || $('Slack: Alert').first().json.error.description || JSON.stringify($('Slack: Alert').first().json.error)).slice(0, 200) + '), so here it is: ' + $('Finish Reply').first().json.alert : '')].filter(Boolean).join(' ') }}

parameters.content:
## 6. Weekly Slack digest
Mondays at 8 AM (the workflow's time zone), or on demand with a POST to the digest webhook and the same secret. Requests and reminders are counted from the times saved on the GoHighLevel contacts, replies from the reply log, open recovery tasks from GoHighLevel. If a GoHighLevel call fails, no digest is posted and the run fails.

parameters.errorMessage: A call to the digest webhook arrived without the right shared secret and was ignored.

={{ $('Build Digest').first().json.fail || ('The weekly review digest could not be posted to Slack: ' + String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || JSON.stringify($json.error))) || 'unknown error').slice(0, 300)) }}
